boxes.title: Crude oil through the Strait of Hormuz
boxes.why: Crude oil only, from every country on the Gulf, Iran included
boxes.note: TankerTrackers has published nothing newer. Kpler, which counts differently (about 13.5 before the war), put it at 8.5 in the week to 7 Oct, about 40% below.

boxes.title: LNG through the Strait of Hormuz
boxes.note: Kpler counted single figures in April and May, and fewer than in June in July and August. The US EIA put LNG through the Strait at 10.5 billion cubic feet a day before the war (late 2025) and 0.8 in April – June.
